g.text: U.S. regional aging and manufacturing structure in 2022

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: 51 regions, ordered by aging rate in both panels; each region receives equal weight.
Sources: Census Vintage 2022 (July 1 population); BEA SAGDP2, CY2022 (September 30, 2026 release).
Manufacturing share measures economic output, not employment. Values rounded to one decimal.
